name: Tushen Microsoft 365 da Google Docs
objectives: Ta amfani da Google Docs ko Word na intanet, buɗe sabuwar takarda mara komai, ba ta suna mai sarari da faɗin inda aka ajiye ta, da sunan da ke faɗin mene ne fayil ɗin da kuma ambaton ma'ajiyar intanet daidai (Google Drive ko OneDrive)

Idan aka ba ku shafin rubutu na yau da kullum, tsara take, jerin abubuwa masu ɗigo da babban rubutu don shafin ya zama mai sauƙin karantawa, da take a Heading 1, jerin abubuwa masu ɗigo da kalma ɗaya mai kauri

Idan aka ba ku takarda da mutumin da ke buƙatar ganinta, raba takardar a mafi ƙanƙantar matakin izini da mutumin yake buƙata da barin sharhi, kuna zaɓar matakin da ya dace kowane lokaci kuma ba ku taɓa amfani da "Anyone with the link" don bayanan sirri ba
Ta amfani da Google Sheets ko Excel na intanet, ƙirƙirar spreadsheet mai kanun bayanai a layi na 1 da layukan bayanai biyar, da abu ɗaya a kowane layi da lambobin da aka rubuta ba tare da kalmomi ba
Idan aka ba ku jerin lambobi a ginshiƙi a cikin spreadsheet, rubuta formula ta SUM da ke haɗa ginshiƙin kuma take sabunta kanta, da jimla daidai da ke canjawa idan aka canja wata lamba

Idan aka ba ku takarda ko spreadsheet da aka gama, sauke ta a matsayin PDF da buga ta bayan duba hoton gabanin bugawa (preview), kuna samun PDF ɗin a babban fayil na Downloads kuma babu abin da aka yanke a cikin preview

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Rubutu da raba takarda

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Buɗe Google Docs ko Word na intanet
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Buɗe sabuwar takarda mara komai, ba ta suna, da sanin inda aka ajiye ta.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da Google Docs ko Word na intanet, za ku iya buɗe sabuwar takarda mara komai, ba ta suna mai sarari da faɗin inda aka ajiye ta, da sunan da ke faɗin mene ne fayil ɗin da kuma ambaton ma'ajiyar intanet daidai (Google Drive ko OneDrive).
Google Docs kyauta ne da asusun Google (asusu ɗaya da Gmail). Ku je docs.google.com ku zaɓi Blank document (takarda mara komai). Microsoft Word na intanet kyauta ne da asusun Microsoft (asusu ɗaya da Outlook.com). Ku je microsoft365.com, ku zaɓi Word, sannan Blank document.
Dukkansu biyu suna ajiye aikinku da kansu yayin da kuke rubutu. Google yana ajiye shi a Google Drive; Microsoft yana ajiye shi a OneDrive. Dukkansu ma'ajiyar intanet ne, wadda ake kira cloud (gajimare), don haka kuna iya sake buɗe fayil ɗin daga kowace kwamfuta ko waya bayan kun shiga asusunku.
Ku ba kowane fayil suna mai sarari a saman hagu, kamar "Volunteer Day Flyer - May" (Takardar Ranar Sa-kai - Mayu). Sunaye masu sarari suna sa a sami fayiloli cikin sauƙi daga baya.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku je docs.google.com (Google) ko microsoft365.com (Microsoft) ku shiga asusunku.
- Ku zaɓi takarda mara komai.
- Ku danna sunan da ke saman hagu ku rubuta sunan fayil mai sarari.
- Ku rubuta jimla ɗaya ku duba saƙon cewa an ajiye, kusa da sama.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Cloud (gajimare): ma'ajiya a intanet, don ku iya kaiwa ga fayilolinku daga kowace na'ura bayan kun shiga asusu.
- Google Drive / OneDrive: ma'ajiyar intanet ta Google da ta Microsoft, inda ake ajiye fayilolinku.
- Asusu (account): sunan shiga da kalmar sirrinku na wata hidima.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Microsoft: free Word, Excel and PowerPoint for the web
- Google Docs
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe takarda mara komai a Google Docs ko Word na intanet. Ku sa mata suna "My Practice Document" (Takardar Atisayena) ku rubuta jimla ɗaya game da makonku.
Yanzu za ku iya buɗe sabuwar takarda, ba ta suna, da sanin cewa tana ajiye kanta a cloud.

options: Ma'ajiyar intanet da kuke iya kaiwa daga kowace na'ura bayan kun shiga asusu
Babban fayil da ke kan kwamfuta ɗaya kawai
Manhajar biyan kuɗi da dole ku saya
check.why: Google Drive da OneDrive ma'ajiyar intanet ne, wadda ake kira cloud.

check.q: Kun rubuta wasiƙa a Google Docs kuma kuna son sake samun ta mako mai zuwa. Me za ku yi yanzu?
options: Ku buga ta don kada ta ɓace
Ku danna sunan da ke saman hagu ku rubuta suna mai sarari kamar "Letter to Landlord - June"
Ku kwafe ta a imel zuwa kanku
check.why: Sunan fayil mai sarari yana sa a sami takardar cikin sauƙi daga baya.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Sa takarda ta yi kyau
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Tsara take, jeri da babban rubutu don shafi ya zama mai sauƙin karantawa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku shafin rubutu na yau da kullum, za ku iya tsara take, jerin abubuwa masu ɗigo da babban rubutu don shafin ya zama mai sauƙin karantawa, da take a Heading 1, jerin abubuwa masu ɗigo da kalma ɗaya mai kauri.
Tsarawa (formatting) yana nufin canja yadda rubutu yake. Da farko ku zaɓi rubutun: ku riƙe maɓallin mouse ku ja shi a kan rubutun, ko ku danna kalma sau biyu. Sannan ku yi amfani da layin maɓallai (toolbar) da ke sama: B don kauri (bold), I don karkata (italic), akwatin girma don ƙara girman rubutu, da maɓallan jeri don ɗigo ko lambobi.
Ku yi amfani da salon Heading (kanu) don take. A toolbar ku nemi akwatin da ke cewa "Normal text" (Google) ko "Normal" (Word) ku zaɓi Heading 1. Kanu suna da kyau kuma suna taimakon manhajojin karanta allo (screen readers) ga makafi.
Ku sauƙaƙa: nau'in rubutu (font) ɗaya mai sauƙin karantawa, girma 11 zuwa 14 don babban rubutu, take mai kauri, gajerun sakin layi da jerin abubuwa masu ɗigo. Idan kun yi kuskure, ku danna Ctrl+Z (Command+Z a Mac) don sokewa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku zaɓi rubutun da kuke son canjawa.
- Ku zaɓi Heading 1 don take.
- Ku zaɓi wasu layuka ku danna maɓallin jeri mai ɗigo.
- Ku yi amfani da B don sa wata muhimmiyar kalma ta yi kauri.
- Ku danna Ctrl+Z (Command+Z a Mac) don soke kuskure.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tsarawa (formatting): canja yadda rubutu yake: girma, kauri, jeri, kanu.
- Zaɓa (select): yi wa rubutu alama ta hanyar ja mouse a kansa don ku iya canja shi.
- Toolbar: layin maɓallai da ke saman manhajar.
Gwada yanzu: A takardar atisayenku, ku rubuta take da abubuwa uku, kamar abubuwa uku da za a kawo wajen shaƙatawar iyali. Ku sa take ya zama Heading 1, ku sa abubuwan su zama jeri mai ɗigo, ku sa kalma ɗaya ta yi kauri.
Yanzu za ku iya tsara shafi da kanu, jeri mai ɗigo da rubutu mai kauri.

check.q: Wane girman rubutu darasin ya ba da shawara don babban rubutu?
check.why: Girma 11 zuwa 14 yana da sauƙin karantawa don babban rubutu.

check.q: Kuna son layuka uku su zama jeri mai ɗigo. Me za ku fara yi?
options: Ku canja font na dukkan shafin
check.why: Da farko kuna zaɓar rubutu, sannan ku zaɓi maɓallin jeri mai ɗigo.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Rabawa lafiya da amfani da sharhi
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Raba takarda da mutum ɗaya a matakin izini da ya dace da barin sharhi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku takarda da mutumin da ke buƙatar ganinta, za ku iya raba takardar a mafi ƙanƙantar matakin izini da mutumin yake buƙata da barin sharhi, kuna zaɓar matakin da ya dace kowane lokaci kuma ba ku taɓa amfani da "Anyone with the link" don bayanan sirri ba.
Dukkan manhajojin biyu suna da maɓallin Share (raba) a saman dama. Ku rubuta adireshin imel na mutumin ku zaɓi abin da zai iya yi: view only (karantawa kawai), comment (ba da shawara), ko edit (canja fayil ɗin). Ku ba da mafi ƙanƙantar matakin da mutumin yake buƙata.
Ku yi hankali da "Anyone with the link" (duk wanda ke da hanyar haɗi). Duk wanda ya sami hanyar haɗin, ko da ta hanyar turawa ne, zai iya buɗe fayil ɗin. Kada ku yi amfani da shi don fayiloli masu bayanan sirri kamar adireshi, lambobin shaida ko bayanan lafiya.
Sharhi (comments) suna bar mutane su ba da ra'ayi ba tare da canja kalmominku ba. Ku zaɓi wani rubutu, sannan ku zaɓi maɓallin sharhi (alamar kumfar magana) ko ku danna dama ku zaɓi Comment. Idan an gyara matsalar, ku zaɓi Resolve (warware).
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku danna Share a saman dama.
- Ku rubuta adireshin imel na mutumin.
- Ku zaɓi View, Comment ko Edit; ku ɗauki mafi ƙanƙantar matakin da yake buƙata.
- Ku aika.
- Don sharhi: ku zaɓi rubutu, ku zaɓi Comment, ku rubuta, sannan ku saka shi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Rabawa (share): bar wani mutum ya buɗe fayil ɗinku.
- Matakin izini (access level): abin da mutum zai iya yi da fayil ɗinku: karantawa, sharhi ko canjawa.
- Sharhi (comment): rubutu a gefen fayil da ba ya canja rubutun.
Gwada yanzu: Ku raba takardar atisayenku da aboki ko ɗan iyali a matsayin view only. Sannan ku ƙara sharhi a kan takenku da ke cewa "Shin wannan take yana da sarari?"
Yanzu za ku iya raba takarda a matakin izini da ya dace da amfani da sharhi don samun ra'ayi.

check.q: Wane matakin izini ne ke bar wani ya canja kalmomin fayil ɗinku?
check.why: Edit yana bar mutum ya canja fayil ɗin; view da comment ba sa yi.

check.q: Wani aboki ya gyara matsalar da kuka ambata a sharhi. Me za ku yi da sharhin?
options: Ku raba fayil ɗin da Anyone with the link
Ku bar sabon sharhi a kowane layi
check.why: Resolve yana rufe sharhi da zarar an gyara matsalar.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Spreadsheet da kammala aiki

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Spreadsheet ɗinku na farko
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Yi spreadsheet mai kanun bayanai da layukan bayanai biyar.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da Google Sheets ko Excel na intanet, za ku iya ƙirƙirar spreadsheet mai kanun bayanai a layi na 1 da layukan bayanai biyar, da abu ɗaya a kowane layi da lambobin da aka rubuta ba tare da kalmomi ba.
Spreadsheet tebur ne na akwatuna don jerin abubuwa da lambobi. Na Google shi ne Sheets (sheets.google.com); na Microsoft shi ne Excel (ku zaɓi Excel a microsoft365.com). Yana da kyau sosai don kasafin kuɗi, jerin sunaye, jadawali da lissafin kayayyaki.
Ginshiƙai (columns) suna tafiya sama da ƙasa kuma suna da haruffa (A, B, C). Layuka (rows) suna tafiya daga gefe zuwa gefe kuma suna da lambobi (1, 2, 3). Kowane akwati cell ne, kuma ana kiransa da sunan ginshiƙinsa da layinsa, don haka B2 shi ne ginshiƙi B, layi na 2.
Ku saka kanun bayanai a layi na 1, kamar "Item" (Abu) a A1 da "Cost" (Kuɗi) a B1. Sannan ku rubuta abu ɗaya a kowane layi a ƙasa. Ku rubuta lambobi ba tare da kalmomi ba (12.50, ba "12.50 dollars" ba) don spreadsheet ɗin ya iya yin lissafi da su.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe Google Sheets ko Excel na intanet ku zaɓi spreadsheet mara komai.
- Ku ba fayil ɗin suna.
- Ku rubuta kanun bayanai a layi na 1 (A1: Item, B1: Cost).
- Ku rubuta abubuwa biyar a ginshiƙi A da kuɗinsu a ginshiƙi B.
- Ku sa layi na 1 ya yi kauri.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Spreadsheet: tebur na cells don jerin abubuwa da lambobi, kamar Google Sheets ko Excel.
- Cell: akwati ɗaya a spreadsheet, wanda ake kira da harafin ginshiƙi da lambar layi, kamar B2.
- Ginshiƙi / layi (column / row): ginshiƙai suna tafiya sama da ƙasa (haruffa); layuka suna tafiya daga gefe zuwa gefe (lambobi).
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi spreadsheet mai suna "Practice Budget" (Kasafin Atisaye). Ku saka Item da Cost a layi na 1, sannan kuɗaɗe biyar na gaske na mako ko na wani taro, kamar kayan abinci, kuɗin bas ko kayan ado.
Yanzu za ku iya shirya spreadsheet mai kanun bayanai da layukan bayanai.

options: Akwati ɗaya, wanda ake kira da ginshiƙinsa da layinsa
check.why: Kowane akwati cell ne, kamar B2 don ginshiƙi B, layi na 2.

check.q: Kuna yin jerin sunaye. A ina za ku rubuta kanun bayanai "Name" da "Phone"?
options: A layi na 1, kanu ɗaya a kowane ginshiƙi
check.why: Kanun bayanai suna zuwa a layi na 1, da abu ɗaya a kowane layi a ƙasa.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Haɗa lambobi da formula
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Yi amfani da SUM don haɗa ginshiƙi ta yadda jimlar take sabunta kanta.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku jerin lambobi a ginshiƙi a cikin spreadsheet, za ku iya rubuta formula ta SUM da ke haɗa ginshiƙin kuma take sabunta kanta, da jimla daidai da ke canjawa idan aka canja wata lamba.
Formula tana gaya wa spreadsheet ya yi lissafi. Kowace formula tana farawa da alamar daidai (=). Don haɗa cells B2 zuwa B6, ku danna cell mara komai a ƙasansu ku rubuta =SUM(B2:B6), sannan ku danna Enter.
Alamar colon (:) tana nufin "zuwa", don haka B2:B6 yana nufin B2, B3, B4, B5 da B6. Idan kun canja wata lamba, jimlar tana canjawa da kanta. Wannan shi ne babban amfaninta fiye da na'urar lissafi (calculator).
Wasu sauƙaƙan formula: =AVERAGE(B2:B6) tana ba da matsakaici, kuma =B2*2 tana ninka cell ɗaya sau biyu. Idan kun ga kuskure kamar #NAME?, ku duba rubutun formula da alamar daidai.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku danna cell mara komai a ƙasan lambobinku.
- Ku rubuta =SUM(B2:B6) da cells ɗinku.
- Ku danna Enter.
- Ku canja lamba ɗaya ku kalli jimlar tana sabunta kanta.
- Ku rubuta kalmar Total (jimla) a cell da ke hagunta.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Formula: umarni da ke farawa da = kuma yana gaya wa spreadsheet ya yi lissafi.
- SUM: formula da ke haɗa rukunin cells.
- Range (rukuni): rukunin cells, da ake rubutawa kamar B2:B6 (B2 zuwa B6).
Gwada yanzu: A Practice Budget ɗinku, ku rubuta Total a A7 da =SUM(B2:B6) a B7. Sannan ku canja kuɗi ɗaya ku duba ko jimlar ta canja.
Yanzu za ku iya haɗa ginshiƙi da SUM da sanin cewa jimlar tana sabuntawa idan lambobi sun canja.

check.q: Mene ne babban amfanin formula ta SUM fiye da haɗawa da calculator?
options: Jimlar tana sabunta kanta idan wata lamba ta canja
Tana sa lambobi su yi kauri
Tana raba fayil ɗin da wasu
check.why: Formula tana sake lissafi duk lokacin da wata lamba a cikin rukunin ta canja.

check.q: Kuɗaɗenku suna B2 zuwa B8. Me za ku rubuta a B9 don haɗa su?
check.why: =SUM(B2:B8) tana haɗa B2 zuwa B8; =B2+B8 tana haɗa cells biyu kawai.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Ajiyewa a matsayin PDF da bugawa
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 4
Manufa: Sauke takarda ko spreadsheet a matsayin PDF da buga ta.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku takarda ko spreadsheet da aka gama, za ku iya sauke ta a matsayin PDF da buga ta bayan duba hoton gabanin bugawa (preview), kuna samun PDF ɗin a babban fayil na Downloads kuma babu abin da aka yanke a cikin preview.
PDF fayil ne da yake bayyana iri ɗaya a kowace waya da kwamfuta, kuma mutane ba za su iya canja shi cikin sauƙi ba. Yawancin takardun neman aiki, ofisoshi da makarantu suna neman PDF.
A Google Docs ko Sheets: ku buɗe menu na File, ku zaɓi Download, sannan PDF. A Word ko Excel na intanet: ku buɗe menu na File ku nemi Save as ko Download, sannan ku zaɓi PDF. Fayil ɗin yana zuwa babban fayil na Downloads.
Don bugawa, ku buɗe menu na File ku zaɓi Print, ko ku danna Ctrl+P (Command+P a Mac). Ku fara duba preview don kada a yanke wani abu. A ɗakin karatu, ku tambayi ma'aikata yadda ake biyan kuɗin bugawa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe menu na File.
- Ku zaɓi Download (Google) ko Save as / Download (Microsoft).
- Ku zaɓi PDF.
- Ku nemo fayil ɗin a babban fayil na Downloads.
- Don bugawa: Ctrl+P (Command+P a Mac), ku duba preview, sannan ku buga.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- PDF: nau'in fayil da yake bayyana iri ɗaya a ko'ina kuma yana da wuyar canjawa.
- Babban fayil na Downloads: wurin da ke kan kwamfuta inda fayilolin da aka sauke suke zuwa.
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku yi takardar talla ko wasiƙa mai shafi ɗaya da kanu, jeri mai ɗigo da layin bayanin tuntuɓa, tare da spreadsheet mai kuɗaɗe biyar da jimlar SUM. Ku raba takardar a matsayin view only, sannan ku sauke dukkansu biyu a matsayin PDF.
Yanzu za ku iya kammala takarda da spreadsheet, raba su lafiya, da ajiye su a matsayin PDF.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Takarda mai shafi ɗaya mai kyau Babu take, ko jeri mai ɗigo, ko layin bayanin tuntuɓa. Take mai kauri a Heading 1, jeri mai ɗigo da layin bayanin tuntuɓa, duka a shafi ɗaya. Yana kuma amfani da font ɗaya mai sauƙi, gajerun sakin layi da sunan fayil mai sarari. Rabawa lafiya Ba a raba takardar ba, ko an raba ta da izinin edit ko "Anyone with the link". An raba ta da mutum ɗaya a matsayin view only. An kuma bar sharhi na neman ra'ayi kuma an zaɓi Resolve bayan an sami amsa. Spreadsheet Babu kanun bayanai ko an lissafa ƙasa da kuɗaɗe biyar. Kanun Item da Cost a layi na 1 da aƙalla kuɗaɗe biyar, ɗaya a kowane layi, an rubuta su a matsayin lambobi. Layi na 1 yana da kauri kuma fayil ɗin yana da suna mai sarari. Jimlar SUM An rubuta jimlar da hannu ko formula tana ba da kuskure. Formula ta SUM tana ba da jimla daidai kuma tana sabuntawa idan wani kuɗi ya canja. An kuma rubuta sunan jimlar kuma an ƙara formula ta AVERAGE. PDF Ɗaya ko dukkan fayilolin biyu ba a ajiye su a matsayin PDF ba. An sauke takardar da spreadsheet ɗin duka a matsayin PDF kuma ana iya samun su a Downloads. An kuma duba preview na bugawa don kada a yanke wani abu. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

check.q: A ina PDF da aka sauke yake zuwa yawanci?
check.why: Fayilolin da aka sauke suna zuwa babban fayil na Downloads a na'urarku.

check.q: Kuna shirin buga takardar talla a ɗakin karatu. Me za ku fara yi?
options: Ku buga kwafi goma nan take
Ku duba preview na bugawa don kada a yanke wani abu
Ku mayar da fayil ɗin spreadsheet
check.why: Preview yana nuna ko an yanke wani abu kafin ku biya kuɗin bugawa.
